tagline.en_US: Save links, notes and images in one place, with full-text search and automatic tagging.

description.en_US: Karakeep is a self-hosted application for saving links, notes and images, previously known as Hoarder. It fetches the title, description and images of each link, keeps a copy of the page and indexes everything for full-text search. Items can be organized in lists and tagged automatically with an optional AI provider, and browser extensions and mobile apps add them from anywhere.
